missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Банк' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'открылся'. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine, and 'рядом' adds location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Банк' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'ищу', matching the nominative form. 'Надёжный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'возле'. 'Банка' is the genitive required by 'возле' to mean near the bank. 'Очередь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'нет'. 'Банка' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express absence. 'В этом районе' is prepositional of location.

missions.phrase: Я иду к банку за деньгами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К банку' uses the dative 'банку' after 'к' to show the destination. 'За деньгами' is the instrumental of purpose.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'доволен'. 'Банком' is the instrumental governed by the short adjective 'доволен'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В банке' uses the prepositional 'банке' after 'в' to say where one works. 'Большом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В банке' again takes the prepositional 'банке' to mean inside the bank. 'Деньги' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Банки' is the nominative plural of 'банк', the subject of 'открылись'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural, and 'в городе' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Банков' is the genitive plural of 'банк', showing whose conditions. 'Разных' agrees in the genitive plural.
